svg.text: Casino sign - layout of the LED strips (to scale, dimensions in cm)
3 strips, 14 pieces, 164 LEDs (LED pitch 16.7 mm, 60 LEDs per metre) + the arrow: 10 Grove sticks of 10 LEDs + the CLOSED light: stick 11.
one strip, one piece per letter,
Grove stick BEHIND the plate (real size,
dashed): its 74 x 4 mm LED window lights
the CLOSED hole text (about 10 x 2.5 cm)
while the casino is closed; put frosted
plastic between the stick and the hole
10 Grove RGB LED sticks, 10 LEDs each
(shield connector; number as on the drawing)
dot = the ball of the stick, real size
= first LED of the strip (DIN, index #0)
Numbers next to the pieces and inside the letter circles are LED counts. #a-b are LED indexes in the sketch.
The gaps between strips are drawn only for clarity: on the real sign the strips touch each other.
A letter group may be laid out behind its letter in any shape; the circle is only an illustration.
